name: Quick Hourglass (waves drop)
notes: A drop of the waves mode: the classic run's Quick Hourglass (an hourglass with cream caps and yellow sand running down), with the same look and the same boost. A wave monster that faints has a 25% chance to drop one of the 5 items, picked at random (item 4 of drop_kind; at most 3 Quick Hourglasss per run, see enm_wave_1). It appears at the monster's feet, or, when the monster fainted in the dark edge the player can't walk into, on the nearest spot of lit floor (free_spot). Only the player can pick it up (monsters walk over it): walking into it plays the item chime, floats '-10% RECHARGE' over the player and all 3 of the player's moves recharge in 10% less time for the rest of the run (boost_charge). It adds to the same variable as the Hourglass level-up card, so the two boosts add up. It stays on the floor until it is picked up or the run ends.
